  I don't think the future of AI content creation is writing better prompts forever. Think about it. If you have to explain yourself to AI every single time you want it to create something, you're doing the work manually. "Here's my business." "Here's my audience." "Here's what I believe." "Here's my tone." "Here's what I sell." "Here's what happened to me." "Here's what I want to say." Then: "Now write the post." What if you didn't have to repeat all of that? What if your AI already understood you? That's the direction I'm interested in. Instead of: Prompt → Generate I'm thinking more like: Know me → Understand the context → Help me create That's a fundamentally different relationship with AI. And it's one of the ideas behind TheAlterMeAI.
